title: The Vanished Rubber Duck
intro: Mo's lucky rubber duck, the one that has sat on the common room TV for three years, has disappeared just before the dorm's big bath-night toast.

suspects.name: Rosa
suspects.line: Ducks are for bathtubs, not for stealing.

suspects.name: Theo
suspects.line: I was asleep. Ask my snoring neighbor.

suspects.name: June
suspects.line: I was on the couch the whole evening, honest.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I only came down for the popcorn, I swear.

suspects.name: Kai
suspects.line: Me? I was busy with my headphones on.

clues.text: A mug still steaming in the sink shows hot cocoa was made here, so the culprit is definitely not the hot cocoa drinker.
The sign-in sheet at the common room door proves the duck was not last seen there, since its visitor timed out long before.
A fizzy soda can was left sweating on the counter, and the culprit is the one who drinks fizzy soda.
A receipt from the kitchen shows someone was seen there at the time, so the culprit was not last seen in the kitchen.
